title: Tick Tick Tick...
cn: 第 10 集 · 滴答滴答
novel: Barney and Robin [[hid|hide]] a [[secret|secret]] from their [[significant|significant]] others. They had shared a moment together that they both [[regretted|regret]]. They agreed to never talk about it again, but the [[guilt|guilt]] [[weighed|weigh]] heavily on both of them. They tried to act normal around Kevin and Nora, but it was [[difficult|difficult]]. Robin felt [[terrible|terrible]] about [[cheating|cheat]] on Kevin, who was kind and good to her. Barney also felt bad about [[betraying|betray]] Nora's [[trust|trust]]. The gang attended a concert together that evening. The [[music|music]] was loud and [[energetic|energetic]], but Robin and Barney could not enjoy it. They kept [[exchanging|exchange]] guilty [[glances|glance]] across the crowd. Ted noticed that something was wrong with both of them. He asked if they were feeling okay, but they both said they were fine. Marshall and Lily were too busy [[dancing|dance]] and having fun to notice. The concert was [[amazing|amazing]], but Robin and Barney could not stop thinking about their mistake. After the concert, Robin [[confessed|confess]] to Kevin about what happened. Kevin was [[heartbroken|heartbroken]] and needed time to think. Barney also told Nora the truth, and she was [[devastated|devastate]]. Both relationships were [[damaged|damage]] by the secret. Robin and Barney realized that actions have [[consequences|consequence]].

guilt.en: a bad feeling about wrong actions

cheat.en: to be unfaithful in a relationship
